name: fixed_top_one_percent_background_negative_aggregation
purpose: One bounded engineering control to test difficult-background supervision before data-composition comparisons.
hypothesis_not_established: Mean negative loss may constrain high-score backgrounds insufficiently; concentration on hard pixels may recover a usable detection-background tradeoff.
only_changed_factor: negative aggregation within each training window
control: lambda0_control: mean softplus over all existing background-mask pixels in each window

treatment.selection: largest raw logits in each existing window background mask across T,H,W; ties broken deterministically by flattened index
treatment.k: max(1,ceil(0.01*N)) for N>0; existing zero-loss handling if N=0
treatment.loss: mean softplus over selected pixels, then equal mean over four windows

fixed.initialization: same original released checkpoint as lambda0 control, not lambda0 final checkpoint
fixed.fusion_and_matching: unchanged existing probability max / component peak / original one-to-one point-box diagnostic

next_trial_joint_readiness_criteria.outside_foreground_cap_scope: New prospective criterion for the next trial only; not applied retroactively to this round
next_trial_joint_readiness_criteria.additional_pilot_gain: After all joint criteria hold: small matches >720 or losses vs original O <54

report_even_on_failure: losses vs same-arrangement original and original O separately
stop_rule: Run only this fixed-strength contrast. If joint criteria fail, stop this weak-box training control without k/lr/threshold sweeps or extra diagnostic expansion.
claim_limit: No successful method, novelty, temporal cause or official Pd/Fa improvement has been established. This is a training-readiness intervention.
